rangeMap.note: World-view partial native country overview; combined breeding/winter countries, not complete species range, seasonal polygons or whole-country occupancy. 50–54cm. Male round orange head, pinkish red pale-tipped bill, black chest belly undertail, very pale flanks midbrown back. Female contrasting pale face/dark crown. Native core Black Sea to Kazakhstan/W Mongolia adjacent Russia/N Iran, scattered Europe; winter Spain/N Africa/eastern Mediterranean/Pakistan/India; China Xinjiang/Qinghai-Tibet/Inner Mongolia, SW lakes. LC trend unknown. HK accidental not normal range.

Comparison source read: 42–49cm. Domed crown smooth head-bill junction; male reddish eyes orangebrown head, broad pale greyish band on dark bill, black breast/stern, pale grey vermiculated upperparts/flanks. Breeds E Europe/S Scandinavia to Russia/Kazakhstan/Mongolia/NE China, winters western Europe/N and E Africa/N Indian subcontinent/N Indochina/S China/E Asia/N Philippines. VU rapidly decreasing.

Comparison source read: 38–42cm. Steep forehead crown peak intermediate between tufted/common pochard; breeding male dark chestnut, paler flanks darker mantle/back WHITE iris, conspicuous white undertail. Female dull brown dark eye. White flight wingbar not illustrated in folded-wing portraits. Breeds E Europe to western/central Kazakhstan/western Mongolia, disjunct south/N China; China N Xinjiang/N China breeding, Yunnan/Yangtze/Taiwan winter. NT decreasing.
